user_reviews.Name: Ian Schwenke
user_reviews.Description:
The pharmacist (slightly older lady with glasses) told me, and I quote "you are going to die if you keep using this", and "your doctor does not care for you obviously", when I asked for a medication (Fluticasone) that I have been using for 4 years. This is not the first time this has happened, and this pharmacist seems to be very ill-informed, opinionated, and intrusive about a lot of drugs in the store.

If you ignore the unsolicited and false advice and do your own research, this place does have a wonderful array of medicines and drugs available, and is generally better than other pharmacies in the area (if she allows you to have the meds).
